BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

4. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   C. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   D. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

6. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   C. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.

7. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   B. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.

8. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   C. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   D. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

10. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   B. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.

11. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   B. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   D. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   B. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   C. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

14. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   B. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   B. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   D. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Inflation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain National Income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Networking in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Income Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
